about: Guest information for the free hotel list cards of the boards (js/hotel-list-card.js) and the full list in the phone app (app.html). Facts only: name, street address, phone, website, the logo where an official one reads on the cream column. No prices, no offers. Every field keeps the source it was read from and whether it was verified.
runtime: fids-current/data/hotels/yfc.json is made from this file by scripts/hotels/build-runtime.js: only the hotels that are listed and only the fields the cards and the phone app read. Edit this file, then run the script; tests/hotel-list-cards.test.js holds the two to agree.

rules.areas: downtown = within about 2 km of the centre point; airport = within about 5 km of the airport point; resort = a destination resort (resort true) more than 30 km from both points, listed with its drive distance (no tolerance); nearby = the rest within about 30 km of either point. Each about-limit has a 10 % tolerance; downtown is tested first, then airport.
rules.listed: listed false = held back (the reason is given). A listed hotel is shown only while its season is open (season.year_round, or a season.open range that holds the date at the airport).
rules.shuttle: shuttle.mark true only where the shuttle is verified on the hotel's or the airport's own page.
rules.logo: logo.file is loaded through , never inlined; opaque = the file has its own light ground (shown with a multiply blend on the cream column so the box does not show).
rules.logo_fill: logo.fill true = a stacked lockup whose words are small at the common logo height (62 px at 1680x1050): it may take the whole cell of the cream column, the width of the column and the height of its line. The file is shown as it is.

terminal.note: About 0.9 km from the board point. Every hotel falls in the same area from either point (checked 2026-11-22).

centre.note: YFC has no entry in DOWNTOWN_COORDS in fids-core.js (checked on main a390449, 2026-11-22), and none was added (as Charlottetown), so the Accor search for Fredericton is unchanged. Suggested entry: 'YFC': { lat: 45.9636, lng: -66.6432, name: 'Fredericton' }.

notes.verified_definition: verified true = read directly on 2026-11-22 on at least one official page: the hotel's own site, its brand property page, or the Fredericton Capital Region listing (frederictoncapitalregion.ca, the city's official tourism site: tourismfredericton.ca forwards there), and no official page read says otherwise. Where only one official page gives a fact, its note says so (one page is enough, as in the other files). verified false = not read (a page that answered 403), on no official page, or not settled: the note says which. The airport's own site (yfcfredericton.ca) lists no hotels. Tourism New Brunswick (tourismnewbrunswick.ca) answered 403 with a Cloudflare page: blocked, needs a person; not used. OpenStreetMap only found the hotels (scripts/hotels/find-candidates.js YFC --centre 45.96356,-66.64315) and is cited only beside an official page, or for a map point.
notes.postal_note: Postal codes are not shown on the cards. The Fredericton Capital Region listing prints none, so no postal code has two official pages: every one is marked verified false (one page) or left empty.
notes.shuttle_note: No Fredericton hotel carries the shuttle mark. The airport's Ground Transportation Services page (yfcfredericton.ca, read 2026-11-22) names car rentals, taxis (Checker Cab, Trius, Loyal) and ridesharing, and no hotel shuttle; no hotel page read names one. shuttle.offered null = unknown.
notes.season_note: season.year_round true is the city-hotel default: the listings state no dates and no page read states a season or a closure, so season.verified is false everywhere. Riverside Resort says its pool and hot tub are closed for repair, not the hotel.
sources: Fredericton Capital Region listings, frederictoncapitalregion.ca (the city's official tourism site; tourismfredericton.ca forwards there): the Hotels pages and each listing page read directly, three seconds apart

Fredericton International Airport, yfcfredericton.ca (frederictonairport.ca forwards there): Ground Transportation Services, Getting to and from YFC and Tourism Information pages, read directly; no hotel list

Hotels' own sites (Amsterdam Inns, Ramada Fredericton, Fredericton Inn, Riverside Resort) and the Wyndham and Best Western property pages, read directly; Marriott, IHG, Hilton, Choice and Radisson pages answered 403
Tourism New Brunswick (tourismnewbrunswick.ca): answered 403 (Cloudflare) on 2026-11-22, blocked, needs a person; not used

OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (ODbL): credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors". Candidates only (scripts/hotels/find-candidates.js, 2026-11-22), the two points, and the map point of Riverside Resort
